a.name: OpenAI GPT-4 via OpenAI's GPT API
a.locator: PDF p. 7, Writer study and experimental conditions; model release year is not stated

b.name: OpenAI GPT-4 via OpenAI's GPT API
b.locator: PDF p. 7, Writer study and experimental conditions, paragraph describing randomized conditions and the fixed story-idea prompt; model release year not printed

a.name: Human-only
a.description: Write a story with no mention of or access to generative AI. The analyzed arm count is not printed (PDF pp. 2, 7).

a.name: Human with one GenAI idea
a.description: Option to request one three-sentence story idea from GPT-4 through a fixed prompt; the idea cannot be copied and pasted. The analyzed count is printed in Results (PDF p. 2); intervention details are on PDF p. 7.

a.name: Human with five GenAI ideas
a.description: Option to request up to five three-sentence story ideas from GPT-4 through fixed prompts; all requested ideas remain visible and cannot be copied and pasted. The analyzed count is printed in Results (PDF p. 2); intervention details are on PDF p. 7.

b.name: Human-only
b.description: Write without any mention of or access to generative AI. Writers admitting outside AI use were excluded. The analyzed arm count is not printed (PDF pp. 2, 7).

b.name: Human with one GenAI idea
b.description: Optional request for one three-sentence GPT-4 story idea from a fixed prompt; the writer then writes the story and cannot copy and paste the idea. Analyzed count is printed in PDF p. 2, Results: Of the 100 writers in the Human with one GenAI idea condition.

b.name: Human with five GenAI ideas
b.description: Optional requests for up to five three-sentence GPT-4 story ideas from fixed prompts; all requested ideas remain visible and cannot be copied and pasted. Analyzed count is printed in PDF p. 2, Results: 93 of 98 writers in this condition requested an idea.
